subject: general
question: Which city in Uttar Pradesh was awarded the first prize under the Medium-sized Cities category (Population between 3 lakh and 10 lakh) in the Swachh Vayu Survekshan 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Firozabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Firozabad was awarded the first prize under the Medium-sized Cities category (Population between 3 lakh and 10 lakh) in the Swachh Vayu Survekshan 2024.
 
• Swachh Vayu Survekshan is an initiative by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) to monitor and improve air quality in Indian cities.
 
• The award recognizes the city’s efforts in implementing effective measures for air pollution control and management.
 
• Firozabad’s initiatives included promoting the use of electric vehicles, enhancing green cover, and strict monitoring of industrial emissions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swachh Vayu Survekshan**

 
 
• Launched by the MoEFCC to assess and rank cities based on air quality management efforts.
 
• The survey covers various parameters including vehicular pollution, industrial emissions, and waste management.
 
• Aims to encourage cities to adopt sustainable and effective practices for improving air quality.
 
 
 
• **Electric Vehicles (EVs)**
 
 
• EVs are vehicles that use electric motors powered by electricity from batteries or fuel cells.
 
• They produce zero tailpipe emissions, contributing significantly to the reduction of urban air pollution.
 
 
 
• **Green Cover**
 
 
• Refers to the presence of vegetation such as trees, shrubs, and grasses in urban areas.
 
• Enhancing green cover helps in improving air quality by absorbing pollutants and providing oxygen.
 
 
 
• **Industrial Emissions**
 
 
• Emissions from industrial activities include pollutants like sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, and particulate matter.
 
• Strict monitoring and regulation of these emissions are crucial for maintaining air quality.
